intro: Our goal is simple: bring free party back to the South East of England. Good vibes, proper sound, and a safe, friendly place to rave.

collective.heading: The Collective
collective.statement: We keep the names and identities of our organisers and collective members hidden — protecting the people behind the stack from those who want to bring a stop to us.

roles.description: We put smaller underground DJs and artists on our decks — everyone deserves a chance to play on a proper system, no following required. Backed by two resident DJs who keep the standard set.
The people that bring the night to the punters! It's a labour of love — long hours, cold hands, heavy boxes and a week of planning for a single night of like-minded people having it large.
They shoot the night from load-in to pack-down. Faces stay out of frame or out of the archive — privacy first, always. If you spot yourself and want it gone, it's gone.

standards.heading: Our Standards
standards.intro: It's a community effort. Here's the deal:
points: We expect everyone to respect their fellow ravers
Look out for each other — don't be a bystander
We expect everyone to take their rubbish home — Leave No Trace
We expect everyone to respect the Police and the Location
Respect the rig — drivers cost more than your phones so hands off, no drinks on the boxes
No fights, no weapons, no exceptions — you will be dealt with accordingly and the appropriate authorities will be notified
standards.outro: Party organisers put in a lot of risk for your enjoyment and the love of the game! Please respect our simple rules so we can all enjoy the party.
